paite: Huai lai in hichi ahong hi a, asanggamte kiang a kipan Judah apaisuk a, Adullam mi khat amin Hirah ava bel hi.
heading: Judah Leh Tamar
english: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

paite: Judah in huai ah Kanaan mi khat tanu amin Shuah amu a; akitenpih a, akithuahpih hi.
english: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.

paite: Huchi in agai a, tapa anei a; Judah in amin Er asa hi.
english: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.

paite: Agai nawn a, tapa anei nawn a; anu'n amin Onan asa hi.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.

paite: Tapa anei nawn a, amin Shelah asa a; amah aneih lai in Kezib ah Judah a-om hi.
english: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.

paite: Judah in ata masa Er a ding in zi apisak a, amin Tamar ahi.
english: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in Judah ta masa Er agilou a; TOUPA'N amah athat hi.
english: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight. So Yahweh killed him.

paite: Judah in Onan kiang ah, "Na upa zi kitenpih inla kithuahpih in, na upa a ding in chi suahsak in," achi hi.
english: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”

paite: Onan in chisuah ding pen ama suan ahi kei ding chih athei hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, a-upa zi akithuahpih teng in a-upa a ding a chi asuahsaklouhna ding in lei ah achi akesak zel hi.
english: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.

paite: Athilhih in TOUPA alungkimsak kei a, huaiziak in amah leng TOUPA'N athat hi.
english: The thing which he did was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and he killed him also.

paite: Judah in amounu Tamar kiang ah, "Ka tapa Shelah apichin mateng na pa inn ah meithai in va om tadih phot in. Huchi lou in zaw amah leng asanggamte bang in asi kha ding,” achi hi. Huchi in Tamar apai a, apa inn ah ava omta hi.
english: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.

paite: Anung in Shuah tanu Judah zi asi a; Judah ahong khamuantak in, Timnah ah abelam mulmette kiang ah alawm Adullam mi Hirah toh ahohtou uhi.
english: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.

paite: Mi'n Tamar, "Na pasal pa, abelam mul met ding in Timnah ah ahohtou," chi in ahilh uhi.
english: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

paite: Apasal suunna puansilhte asuah a, kikhuhna puan in akikhuh a, akituam bikbek a, Enaim kulh kongpi a Timnah kho lampi ah ana tu hi. Shelah apichingta ngal a, apa'n azi ding in amah apisak kei, chih athei hi.
english: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.

paite: Judah in amah amuh in kizuak hi in teh achi a; amai lah akikhuh bikbek ngal a.
english: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

paite: Lampi gei a om huai numei ava zuan a, "Kisa in, hehpih in i lumkhawm ding," achi hi (amou mah ahi chih lah athei ngal kei a). Ama'n, "Hon kithuahpih leng bang na hon pe dia?" achi hi.
english: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”

paite: Ama'n, "Ganhon lak a kipan kelnou ka hon khak ding,” achi hi. Ama'n, "Huai na hon khak ma in kichiamna bang na hon pe dia?” achi hi.
english: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”

paite: Ama'n, "Kichiamna bang ka hon pe dia?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Na minsawnna leh na taute leh na chiangkhun," achi hi. Huchi in hiaite apia a, akithuahpih a, amah a kipan nau apaita hi.
english: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.

paite: Athou a, akikhuhna puan asuah a, ameithai puansilhte asilh nawnta hi.
english: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

paite: Judah in akichiamna numei khut a kipan la ding in alawmpa Adullam mi khut ah kelnou akhak a, himahleh ama'n huai numei ava muzouta kei hi.
english: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.

paite: Huchi in numei omna mun a mite kiang ah, "Lampi gei a Enaim a kizuaknu koi a omta ahia?" chi in adong hi. Amau, “Hiai ah kizuak om kei," achi uhi.
english: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”

paite: Huchi in Judah kiang ah akik nawn a, "Amah ka muzou kei. Amun a mite'n leng kizuak mawngmawng hiai ah a-om kei ana chi uh,” achi hi.
english: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”

paite: Judah in, "Ama'n nei den mai hen, huchi lou in zaw i zahlak kha ding. Ngai in, hiai kelnou khak ing a, amah lah muzou lou chin a,” achi hi.
english: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”

paite: Kha thum vel nung in mi'n, "Judah, na mounu, Tamar kizuak ve aw; huai lou leng, ngai in, sawn apai hi," chi in ahilh uhi. Judah in, “Pikhia hen, unla, hallup in om hen,” achi hi.
english: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”

paite: Apikhiak uleh, Tamar in, “Hiai thilte neipa a kipan ahi nau ka pai," chi in apasal pa kiang ah mi asawl hi. Amah mah in, "Hehpih in hiai minsawnna, taute leh chiangkhun, kua a ahia, ana enchian ding in ka hon ngen," achi hi.
english: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”

paite: Judah in huai thilte amah a ahi, chih ana thei hi. "Kei sang a amah diktatzaw ahi. Ka tapa Shelah lah amah toh ka na kitengsakta kei a," achi hi. Huchi in Judah in amah akithuahpih nawn het kei hi.
english: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.

paite: Huan anau suah hun ahong tun in hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, asul ah phik ana om uhi.
english: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, nau avei lai in khat in akhut ahon golhkhia a; naudommi in, “Hiai pen apawt masazaw ahi," chi in ana len a, akhut ah khau san abunsak hi.
english: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akhut alakkik toh kiton in, ngai in, asanggampa ahong suakkhia hi. Naudommi in, "Bangchidan a nang hon phusuak mawk na hia? Nang amoh khu in," achi hi. Huaiziak in amin Perez asa uhi.
english: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.

paite: Huai nung in asanggampa, akhut a khau san bun pen ahong pawt nawn a, amin Zerah asa uhi.
english: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.
